original.reason: It correctly identifies the zero set as the preimage of the closed singleton {0} under a continuous real-valued function.

judgment.reason: It correctly proves the complement of the zero set is the preimage of an open set and hence open.
It correctly applies preservation of closed sets under inverse images of continuous functions.
It correctly expresses the zero set as the inverse image of the closed singleton {0}.
It is a complete direct application of the closed-preimage characterization of continuity.
